description: This PHP script automates the process of rebuilding bundled plugins for Revive Adserver, including version bumping, zipping, and updating plugin files. It is intended to be run from the command line and contains functions for plugin build, version bump, zip comparison, and version extraction.

methods.name: buildPlugin
methods.description: Builds a plugin by executing a shell script with the plugin name.

methods.name: bumpVersion
methods.description: Updates the plugin version using an Ant command.

methods.name: zipDiff
methods.description: Compares two zip files to detect differences based on file count, size, and CRC.

methods.name: getVersions
methods.description: Extracts current and next version numbers from a plugin's XML file and optionally detects if version has changed via git diff.
